apps.name: CMC invivo dMRI (NORDIC)
apps.summary: Preprocesses in-vivo diffusion MRI (macaque 10.5T by default, or human) with the CMC pipeline: NORDIC or MPPCA denoising, Gibbs and N4 correction, TOPUP/EDDY, DTI fitting, standard-space registration and optional BedpostX + XTRACT tractography, with a QA report.

apps.name: Combine 2D T1w images into a single 3D volume - 2 orientations
apps.summary: Reconstructs a single high-resolution 3D T1-weighted volume from 2 stacks of 2D T1-weighted slices (axial and coronal) using NiftyMIC super-resolution volume reconstruction.

apps.name: Combine 2D T1w images into a single 3D volume - 3 orientations
apps.summary: Reconstructs a single high-resolution 3D T1-weighted volume from 3 stacks of 2D T1-weighted slices (axial, coronal and sagittal) using NiftyMIC super-resolution volume reconstruction.

apps.name: Combine 2D T2w images into a single 3D volume - 2 orientations
apps.summary: Reconstructs a single high-resolution 3D T2-weighted volume from 2 stacks of 2D T2-weighted slices (axial and coronal) using NiftyMIC super-resolution volume reconstruction.

apps.name: Combine 2D T2w images into a single 3D volume - 3 orientations
apps.summary: Reconstructs a single high-resolution 3D T2-weighted volume from 3 stacks of 2D T2-weighted slices (axial, coronal and sagittal) using NiftyMIC super-resolution volume reconstruction.

apps.name: Combine classified white matter tracts
apps.summary: Merges selected tracts of a white matter classification into new combined tracts with MRtrix3 and outputs the updated tractogram and classification.

apps.name: Combine two parcellations into a single parcellation
apps.summary: Merges two volumetric parcellations into one with relabelled consecutive values and a combined label.json, resolving overlaps in favour of the first, the second or neither.

apps.name: combine-scans-rois
apps.summary: Copies a set of ROIs together with a preprocessed DWI and a T1-weighted image into one folder for visual checking.

apps.name: combineROI
apps.summary: Combines two ROI datasets into one by copying all ROI NIfTI files from both inputs into a single ROI folder, renaming duplicates.

apps.name: Compile measures from dsistudio tractmeasures datatype
apps.summary: Compiles per-tract DSI Studio tractmeasures (stat.txt files) from many subjects into one tsv with one column per tract and subject, session and tag columns using pandas; a group-analysis utility.

apps.name: Compile parc-stats csvs across project into one dataframe
apps.summary: Concatenates a chosen parc-stats CSV from many subjects into one group table with pandas, adding subject, session and tag columns, for group analysis.

apps.name: Compile qc data from tractmeasures (tsv) data
apps.summary: Concatenates DSI Studio QC tractmeasure tsv files from many subjects into one tsv with subject, session and tag columns using pandas; a group-analysis utility.

apps.name: Compile tract macro-structural and profile data
apps.summary: Merges tract macrostructural statistics (for example from Tractography Quality Check) with tract profile measures into a single tractmeasures CSV per subject, using pandas.

apps.name: Compile tract profiles to summary structure
apps.summary: Compiles the per-tract profile csv files of one subject's tractprofile output into a single long-format csv (subject, tract, node, mean of each measure) with pandas, for group analysis and machine learning.

apps.name: Compile tractmeasures csvs across project into one dataframe
apps.summary: Concatenates tractmeasures csv files from many subjects into one csv, adding subject, session, tag and datatype-tag columns with pandas; a group-analysis utility.

apps.name: Compute  tSNR of DMRI Images
apps.summary: Computes a temporal signal-to-noise ratio (tSNR) map from the b0 volumes of a DWI with FSL, following the HCP minimal preprocessing pipeline, and masks it to the brain.

apps.name: Compute Anatomical Statistics
apps.summary: Computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics (thickness, surface area, volume, curvature) with mris_anatomical_stats for each parcel of the FreeSurfer aparc and an optional surface parcellation, and outputs merged CSVs.

apps.name: Compute and Apply warp from subject-to-standard space to ROIs (T1w)
apps.summary: Registers a T1-weighted image to a standard template (MNI152 or NIHPD) with FSL flirt and fnirt, then warps a set of ROIs with the resulting warp; also outputs the warp fields.

apps.name: Compute average cortexmap data for group analysis
apps.summary: Averages cortexmap surfaces and surface measures across subjects on a common standard mesh with Connectome Workbench and builds a thresholded group parcellation, for group analysis.

apps.name: Compute average measures per tract
apps.summary: Averages along-tract measures across nodes to give one value per tract and measure, from a tractmeasures CSV, with pandas.

apps.name: Compute dice similarity coefficient between parcels in parcellations
apps.summary: Computes the Dice similarity coefficient of each parcel between a parcellation and a reference parcellation with nibabel and numpy, and outputs a per-parcel csv.

apps.name: Compute ECG artifact SSP projectors
apps.summary: Compute SSP (signal-space projection) vectors for ECG artifacts.

apps.name: Compute ECG artifact SSP projectors - epoched data
apps.summary: Computes signal-space projection (SSP) vectors for ECG (heartbeat) artifacts with MNE-Python compute_proj_ecg and outputs the projectors, topomap and ECG evoked figures and an HTML report.

apps.name: Compute evoked
apps.summary: Computes evoked responses from epoched MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python Epochs.average, optionally one per event type, and outputs an MNE evoked file, a figure and an HTML report.

apps.name: Compute forward model MEEG
apps.summary: Computes an MEG forward solution with MNE-Python from a raw recording, a head-MRI transform and a FreeSurfer subject, building an oct6 source space and a single-layer BEM.

apps.name: Compute headshape.pos file from cHPI recorded during MEG acquisition
apps.summary: Computes time-varying head positions from continuous HPI (cHPI) signals in MEG .fif data with MNE-Python and outputs a headshape.pos file for Maxwell filtering.

apps.name: Compute macro-structural statistics of tracts using Dipy
apps.summary: Computes per-tract macrostructure (streamline count, mean length, mean curvature, voxel count, centroid orientation) from a classified tractogram with DIPY, as a CSV.

apps.name: Compute mean head position across MEG runs
apps.summary: Computes the mean head position (device-to-head transformation matrix) across several MEG runs with MNE-Python, for realigning all runs during Maxwell filtering.

apps.name: Compute myelin map using T1w / T2w ratio
apps.summary: Computes a volumetric myelin map as the T1w/T2w ratio (Glasser and Van Essen 2011) with Connectome Workbench and outputs a myelin-map datatype.

apps.name: Compute Network Backbone
apps.summary: Extracts the backbone of a weighted structural or functional connectivity network with the disparity filter (Serrano et al. 2009) using networkx and igraph, keeping only statistically significant edges.

apps.name: Compute Noise Covariance
apps.summary: Estimates the MEG/EEG noise covariance matrix with MNE-Python from an empty-room recording or the pre-stimulus baseline of epochs (or an ad hoc diagonal covariance from evoked data), with diagnostic plots and a report.

apps.name: Compute Peaks from Spherical Harmonic (SH) data
apps.summary: Extracts fibre orientation peaks from the spherical harmonic FOD at a chosen lmax of a CSD dataset with MRtrix3 sh2peaks, and outputs a peaks image.

apps.name: Compute SNR on Corpus Callosum
apps.summary: Computes the signal-to-noise ratio of DWI in the corpus callosum for the b0 and each gradient direction with DIPY, and outputs SNR statistics and the corpus callosum and noise masks.

apps.name: Compute streamline weights using COMMIT
apps.summary: Filters a whole-brain tractogram with COMMIT, fitting streamline weights to the DWI signal with a microstructure model, and outputs streamline weights, fit errors and compartment maps.

apps.name: Compute streamline weights using SIFT2
apps.summary: Computes per-streamline weights for a whole-brain tractogram with MRtrix3 tcksift2, using the FOD and a 5-tissue-type mask, so streamline counts match the underlying fibre densities.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from Freesurfer Parcellation (volume)
apps.summary: Computes volume, cortical thickness and mean diffusion measures (DTI, optional NODDI, myelin, qMRI) in each ROI of a FreeSurfer <parcellation>+aseg volume with mri_segstats.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from Parcellation (volume)
apps.summary: Computes volume, cortical thickness and mean diffusion measures (DTI, optional NODDI, myelin, qMRI) in each ROI of a volumetric parcellation with FreeSurfer mri_segstats.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from subcortical segmentation
apps.summary: Computes mean diffusion measures (DTI, optional NODDI) and volume within each FreeSurfer aseg subcortical structure with mri_segstats and outputs a parc-stats CSV.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface
apps.summary: Computes per-ROI summary statistics (min, max, mean, median, mode, SD, sample SD, nonzero count) of diffusion measures mapped to the cortical surface for a FreeSurfer aparc or an optional surface parcellation, using Connectome Workbench, and outputs CSVs.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface - Deprecated Surface
apps.summary: This app will This app will compute multiple summary statistics from measures mapped to the cortical midthickness surface on a per-ROI basis.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface - Freesurfer computations
apps.summary: Computes per-ROI statistics of cortex-mapped diffusion measures with FreeSurfer mri_segstats and anatomical measures with mris_anatomical_stats for a FreeSurfer aparc or an optional surface parcellation, and outputs merged CSVs.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to cortical surface - Freesurfer stats - Deprecated Surface
apps.summary: This app will This app will compute multiple summary statistics from measures mapped to the cortical midthickness surface on a per-ROI basis.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures mapped to visual regions binned by eccentricity - Benson14
apps.summary: Computes mean diffusion measures and FreeSurfer anatomical measures (thickness, surface area, volume) within Benson14 visual areas binned by pRF eccentricity, and outputs parc-stats CSVs.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of visual regions binned by pRF - Benson14 - Anatomical Stats
apps.summary: This app will compute the average diffusion metrics, and anatomical measures from Freesurfer including thickness, surface area, and volume, within the visual areas returned by the prf - Benson14 app. Will return a parc-stats datatype for each eccentricity-binned visual area parcellation.

apps.name: Compute summary statistics of visual regions binned by pRF - Benson14 - Anatomical Stats
apps.summary: Computes FreeSurfer anatomical statistics (vertex count, surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, curvature) within Benson14 visual areas, overall and restricted to cortexmap maps, and outputs parc-stats CSVs.

apps.name: Compute summed cortexmap data for group analysis
apps.summary: Sums cortexmap surface measures across subjects on a common standard mesh with Connectome Workbench, averaging the surfaces and building a thresholded group parcellation, for group analysis.

apps.name: Compute T1 and R1 maps from MP2RAGE
apps.summary: Estimates quantitative T1 and R1 maps from a denoised Siemens MP2RAGE acquisition with a lookup-table method (compiled MATLAB, adapted from MP2RAGE-related-scripts).

apps.name: Compute Volume of Binary Nifti images
apps.summary: Computes the volume of each binary tract mask and its proportion of FreeSurfer estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV), saved as JSON.

apps.name: Concatenate raws
apps.summary: Concatenate multiple MNE.Raw instances into single .Raw

apps.name: Concatenating NifTi and Eventfiles
apps.summary: Concatenating single-session, single-subject Nifti files into multiple-session, single-subject Nifti files for first-level GLM Analysis

apps.name: Conmat to network
apps.summary: Utility that converts a connectivity matrix (conmat: CSV matrices, index and labels) into a compressed JSON Graph Format network for the brainlife network pipeline.

apps.name: CONN preprocessing
apps.summary: fMRI preprocessing via CONN

apps.name: Connectivity Gradients
apps.summary: Computes functional connectivity gradients from left and right surface fMRI time series with BrainSpace, using Schaefer-1000 parcel correlations, and outputs the gradients as surface maps.

apps.name: Connectivity Matrix Computation
apps.summary: Computes a structural connectivity matrix between the regions of a volumetric parcellation from an MRtrix tractogram, using MRtrix3 tck2connectome or pairwise tckedit filtering.

apps.name: Connectome Evaluator
apps.summary: Estimate the quality of your diffusion-weighted data to map human connectomes.

apps.name: CONNECTS Validation Engine
apps.summary: Evaluates a 3D segmentation against a ground-truth mask, computing voxel overlap (Dice, IoU, precision, recall), neighbour-tolerant, topology (Betti numbers, Euler characteristic) and connected-component metrics as JSON with QC figures.

apps.name: Convert assignments from structural connectivity to wmc datatype
apps.summary: Converts structural connectivity streamline assignments (streamline-to-node-pair labels) into a white matter classification (wmc) with one tract per connected region pair, using DIPY and pandas.

apps.name: Convert brainmask from dtiinit
apps.summary: Utility that copies the brain mask from a vistasoft dtiInit output (dti/bin/brainMask.nii.gz) into a mask datatype.

apps.name: Convert freesurfer annotations to parcellation
apps.summary: Converts a FreeSurfer 7.3.2 aparc, aparc.a2009s or aparc.DKTatlas +aseg volume into a volumetric parcellation resliced to the T1-weighted image with mri_vol2vol, with a FreeSurfer color-table label.json.

apps.name: Convert hippocampal and amygdala segmentation into parcellation
apps.summary: Converts FreeSurfer hippocampal subfield and amygdala nuclei segmentations (lh/rh hippoAmygLabels) into one volumetric parcellation in T1 space with a label.json.

apps.name: Convert network neuro matrix to conmat
apps.summary: Converts one measure's matrix from the Network Neuro raw networkmatrices output, with its parcellation key, into a conmat datatype.

apps.name: Convert Pial (Cortical) and White Matter Surfaces from Freesurfer
apps.summary: Converts FreeSurfer pial, white, smoothwm and inflated surfaces of both hemispheres to VTK, STL, GIFTI or MGZ meshes with mris_convert.

apps.name: Convert quality control (qc) data from eddy to regressors datatype
apps.summary: Converts eddy quality-control outputs (motion parameters and RMS movement) into a regressors TSV for use as nuisance variables in statistical analyses; a conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert surface datatypes to cortexmap datatype
apps.summary: Converts surface/vertices and surface/data datatypes into a cortexmap, renaming GIFTI files into Connectome Workbench conventions for use with its viewers; a format conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert surface-based annotation in standard space to parcellation (volume)
apps.summary: Converts left and right surface annotations on an fsaverage template into a volumetric parcellation in fsaverage space with FreeSurfer mri_label2vol and Connectome Workbench.

apps.name: Convert tck to trk in DWI space
apps.summary: Converts an MRtrix .tck tractogram to TrackVis .trk format with nibabel, using a DWI image as the reference space for the trk header; a format conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert tck to trk in T1 space
apps.summary: Converts an MRtrix .tck tractogram to TrackVis .trk format with nibabel, using a T1-weighted image as the reference space for the trk header; a format conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert tck+dwi to trk (MRtrix 2)
apps.summary: Converts a tck that was made using MRtrix 2 into a trk in the dwi space.

apps.name: Convert tcks to tck and WMC
apps.summary: Merges a folder of per-tract .tck files (tcks datatype) into a single .tck tractogram and a matching white matter classification (WMC) structure.

apps.name: Convert thalamic segmentation into parcellation
apps.summary: Converts FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei segmentation (ThalamicNuclei.*.FSvoxelSpace.mgz) into a volumetric parcellation in T1 space with a label.json.

apps.name: Convert thalamic, hippocampal and amygdala segmentation into parcellation
apps.summary: Converts FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei and hippocampal/amygdala segmentations into two volumetric parcellations in T1 space, each with a label.json.

apps.name: Convert tractmasks to rois
apps.summary: Converts a tractmasks datatype into a rois datatype by moving the mask files unchanged; a format-conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert tractmeasures datatype to tractprofile datatype
apps.summary: Converts a tractmeasures CSV (all tracts in one table) into the deprecated tractprofile format with one profile CSV per tract, using pandas.

apps.name: Convert trk to tck
apps.summary: Converts a TrackVis .trk tractogram to MRtrix .tck format with NiBabel; a format conversion utility.

apps.name: Convert wmc to multiple trk
apps.summary: Takes a white matter classification resulting from a tract segmentation app and outputs one trk file for each segmented tract.

apps.name: Convert wmc to trk
apps.summary: Convert a white matter classification (wmc) structure to a tractogram as a single trk file

apps.name: Convert wmc to trk
apps.summary: Converts a white matter classification and its .tck tractogram into a single .trk file with nibabel, storing each streamline's tract index as bundle_code.

apps.name: Convert wmc-deprecated to wmc
apps.summary: Converts a deprecated white matter classification (wmc-deprecated, output.mat) into the current wmc datatype (classification.mat with tract JSONs and surfaces).

apps.name: Convert_Tiff_to_Zarr3
apps.summary: Submits a Nextflow job on a SLURM cluster to deskew a TIFF light-sheet image and write it as a Zarr v3 volume, as part of the Allen Institute axonal connectomics pipeline.

apps.name: Coregistration MRI with MEG
apps.summary: Coregisters MEG head coordinates with an MRI (FreeSurfer/BEM subject) using MNE-Python Coregistration with fiducial fitting and ICP, and saves the head-MRI transform with a report.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space)
apps.summary: Maps DTI/DKI tensor measures and optional NODDI volumes onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, following Fukutomi et al. (2018), and outputs a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space) (Noddi)
apps.summary: Maps NODDI (ndi, isovf, odi) volumes onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, following Fukutomi et al. (2018), and outputs a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space) - Myelin Mapping (T1w/T2w ratio)
apps.summary: Maps a T1w/T2w ratio myelin map onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space) - Myelin Mapping (T1w/T2w ratio) (No SNR masking)
apps.summary: Maps a T1w/T2w ratio myelin map onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, without SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native & Template Space) - qMRI
apps.summary: Maps quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF) onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native and template (MNI) space with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space)
apps.summary: Maps DTI/DKI tensor measures and optional NODDI volumes onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, following Fukutomi et al. (2018), and outputs a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) (Noddi)
apps.summary: Maps NODDI (ndi, isovf, odi) volumes onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, following Fukutomi et al. (2018), and outputs a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - Gray Matter Density
apps.summary: Extracts the gray-matter density map from an MRtrix3 5-tissue-type image and maps it onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - Myelin Mapping (T1w/T2w ratio)
apps.summary: Maps a T1w/T2w ratio myelin map onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - Myelin Mapping (T1w/T2w ratio) (No SNR masking)
apps.summary: Maps a T1w/T2w ratio myelin map onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, without SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - qMRI
apps.summary: Maps quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF) onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, with b0 SNR masking, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - qMRI (No SNR masking)
apps.summary: This app will map volumated measure files (i.e. tensor, NODDI) to the cortical surface following Fukutomi et al (2018; 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2018.02.017) using Connectome Workbench.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping - Fukutomi et al  2018 Replication
apps.summary: Maps DTI and NODDI measures onto HCP PostFreeSurfer native and 32k fs_LR cortical surfaces with Connectome Workbench, replicating the Fukutomi et al. (2018) NODDI cortex-mapping pipeline.

apps.name: Cortex Tissue Mapping - Fukutomi et al  2018 Replication - DEPRECATED
apps.summary: This application is a port of the NODDI Cortex Mapping code (https://github.com/RIKEN-BCIL/NoddiSurfaceMapping) developed by Fukutomi et al.

apps.name: CPU Scaling Benchmark
apps.summary: Utility that benchmarks CPU scaling of a fixed PBKDF2 SHA-256 workload across configurable worker counts and reports runtime, speedup, CPU utilisation and memory in an HTML report.

apps.name: Create brainmask of DWI using MrTrix3
apps.summary: Creates a brain mask of a DWI with MRtrix3 dwi2mask, dilated by five voxels.

apps.name: Create Edge Time Series
apps.summary: This app creates an edge by time matrix referred to as Edge Time Series.

apps.name: Create MNI coordinate-based ROIS and warp to subject space
apps.summary: Creates spherical and planar ROIs from MNI coordinates and warps them to a subject's T1 space with ANTs SyN registration, outputting an ROIs directory.

apps.name: Create networkneuro datatype for visualization
apps.summary: Packages a tractogram, a parcellation and connectivity matrices into the networkneuro datatype used by the brainlife.io networkneuro visualizer.

apps.name: Create structural derivatives for cortexmap datatype
apps.summary: Creates a cortexmap from a FreeSurfer output with Connectome Workbench: white, pial, midthickness and inflated GIFTI surfaces in native and MNI space plus a FreeSurfer surface parcellation.

apps.name: Create white matter mask from FA
apps.summary: Creates a binary white matter mask in DWI space by thresholding a fractional anisotropy (FA) map with FSL fslmaths.

apps.name: Crop and Reorient T1
apps.summary: This application will crop and reorient the T1 image to standard orientation and FOV using FSL's fslreorient2std and robustfov.

apps.name: Crop and Reorient T2
apps.summary: This application will crop and reorient the T1 image to standard orientation and FOV using FSL's fslreorient2std and robustfov.

apps.name: Crop raw data
apps.summary: Crops continuous MEG/EEG data (MNE raw FIF) to a time window between tmin and tmax seconds with MNE-Python raw.crop.

apps.name: CTF to mne/raw
apps.summary: Converts MEG CTF data to MNE Raw (fif)

apps.name: DANDI NWB Inspector
apps.summary: Checks a public NWB file on the DANDI Archive against NWB best practices with NWB Inspector, streaming it without a full download, and outputs text and JSON reports.

apps.name: DBB_ANTsCortThickSeg
apps.summary: Segments brain tissues in a T1-weighted image with a customized ANTs antsCorticalThickness.sh using Pediatric Template of Brain Perfusion (PTBP) priors and an optional brain mask, and outputs a tissue segmentation.

apps.name: DBB_DiceScore
apps.summary: Computes the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) between two segmentations (parcellations)

apps.name: DBB_DisSeg
apps.summary: Segments a T1-weighted brain image into CSF, gray matter, white matter, deep gray matter, brainstem and cerebellum with the DBB 3D U-Net (DisSeg, TensorFlow), after ANTs histogram matching.

apps.name: DBB_preprocessing_t1w
apps.summary: Reorients a T1-weighted image to MNI152 (AC-PC) with a given or ANTs-estimated rigid transform and corrects its bias field with N4, as preprocessing for the Distorted Brain Benchmark.

apps.name: Decimate and/or Convert 3D surfaces
apps.summary: Reduces the vertex and face count of 3D surface meshes with VTK decimation and optionally converts them between vtk, ply, stl and glTF formats.

apps.name: DeepRetinotopy
apps.summary: DeepRetinotopy brainlife.io app: predict retinotopic maps from cortical anatomy using geometric deep learning. Based on the original deepRetinotopy model by Fernanda L. Ribeiro et al. (2021, 2024, 2025).

apps.name: Denoise MP2RAGE UNI
apps.summary: Denoises the UNI image of a Siemens MP2RAGE acquisition by robust combination with the two inversion images (Marques MP2RAGE scripts, compiled MATLAB), with a user-given or automatically selected regularisation parameter.

apps.name: Denoising using LPCA
apps.summary: Denoises a DWI series with the DIPY 1.1.1 local PCA (dipy_denoise_lpca) workflow and outputs the denoised DWI with its bvals and bvecs.

apps.name: Denoising using Marcenko-Pastur PCA (MP-PCA)
apps.summary: Denoises DWI with Marcenko-Pastur PCA (MP-PCA) using the DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_denoise_mppca workflow and outputs the denoised DWI with its bvals and bvecs.

apps.name: Denoising using Non Local Means (NLM)
apps.summary: Denoises a DWI series with the DIPY 1.1.1 non-local means (dipy_denoise_nlmeans) workflow and outputs the denoised DWI with its bvals and bvecs.

apps.name: DenseUnet-based Automatic Rapid Tool for brain Segmentation (DARTS)
apps.summary: Segments a T1-weighted image into 102 brain regions, similar to FreeSurfer aparc+aseg, with the DARTS DenseUNet deep learning model and outputs a volumetric parcellation.

apps.name: Detect bad channels using Maxwell Filtering
apps.summary: Detects noisy and flat MEG channels with MNE-Python find_bad_channels_maxwell (Signal Space Separation without applying the filter) and outputs a BIDS channels.tsv marking them bad plus an HTML report.

apps.name: dmipy-jax-fit
apps.summary: Next-gen microstructure imaging with JAX acceleration.

apps.name: Drop bad epochs
apps.summary: Drops bad epochs by index from MNE-Python epoched MEG/EEG data with Epochs.drop, taking indices from a parameter and/or a file, with before/after plots and an HTML report.

apps.name: DSC evaluation (mask - mask)
apps.summary: Computes Dice similarity, Jaccard, sensitivity and TP/FP/FN between corresponding bundles in two collections of tract masks (estimated vs ground truth) using nibabel.

apps.name: DSC evaluation (wmc - wmc)
apps.summary: Computes Dice similarity, weighted Dice, Jaccard, sensitivity and TP/FP/FN between estimated and ground-truth bundles given as white matter classifications (WMC) of a tractogram, using DIPY and nibabel.

apps.name: DSC evaluation (wmc - wmc) - Seperate tractograms
apps.summary: Measures the overlap between estimated and ground-truth white matter bundles, given as WMC classifications of two separate tractograms, with the Dice similarity coefficient, Jaccard index and sensitivity.

apps.name: dsi-studio-atk
apps.summary: DSI Studio augmented fiber tracking and automatic segmentation for mapping major white matter pathways (Yeh, Neuroimage, 2020). The pathway includes projection, association, and commissural pathways.

apps.name: dsi-studio-dwi2src
apps.summary: DSI Studio scripts converting DWI file to SRC format.

apps.name: dsi-studio-qc
apps.summary: Quality control for DWI data

apps.name: dsi-studio-src2fib
apps.summary: Reconstruction of DWI signals to extract fiber orientations.

apps.name: dsi-studio-trk
apps.summary: DSI Studio fiber tracking

apps.name: dsi-studio-trk-ana
apps.summary: Computes tract shape and size measures (length, span, volume, diameter, surface area, curl, elongation, irregularity) from a DSI Studio tinytrack file with DSI Studio and outputs a TSV table.

apps.name: dsi-studio-trk2tt
apps.summary: Convert TinyTrack format to TRK format

apps.name: dsi-studio-tt2trk
apps.summary: Convert TRK format to TinyTrack format

apps.name: dt6 To Nifti Converter
apps.summary: Converts a dtiInit dt6.mat tensor fit into NIfTI maps of FA, MD, AD, RD and the Westin shape indices (cl, cp, cs) with vistasoft.

apps.name: DTI Metrics-to-Anatomical Registration

apps.name: Generate figures of whole-brain tractogram (tck)
apps.summary: Renders PNG images of a whole-brain .tck tractogram from four views (axial, coronal, left and right sagittal) with DIPY/VTK for visual quality assurance.

apps.name: Generate image of ODF
apps.summary: Renders PNG images of fibre orientation distribution functions (ODFs) from CSD spherical-harmonic coefficients for a chosen sub-volume, using DIPY visualisation.

apps.name: Generate images of all DWI volumes and create gif
apps.summary: Generates a slice PNG of every volume of a DWI with FSL slicer and combines them into an animated GIF with ImageMagick, for quick volume-by-volume QA.

apps.name: Generate images of data mapped to cortical surface
apps.summary: Renders JPEG images of cortical surface maps (cortexmap) on FreeSurfer or fsaverage surfaces with PySurfer, for visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of DWI
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a DWI image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of DWI overlaid on T1
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of the brain-extracted b0 of a DWI overlaid on a T1-weighted image with FSLeyes, to check DWI-to-T1 registration.

apps.name: Generate images of FLAIR
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a FLAIR image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of fMRI
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a fMRI (task) image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of fMRI overlaid on T1
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of the first fMRI volume, brain-extracted with FSL bet, overlaid on a T1-weighted image with FSLeyes, to check fMRI-to-T1 registration.

apps.name: Generate images of mask overlaid on DWI
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a brain mask overlaid on a DWI image with FSL slicer, to check brain extraction.

apps.name: Generate images of masks
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a mask image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of NODDI
apps.summary: Generates PNGs of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of the NODDI NDI, ODI and ISOVF maps with FSL slicer, for quick QA of a NODDI fit.

apps.name: Generate images of NODDI - Deprecated
apps.summary: Create mid-axial, sagittal, and coronal slice pngs of the NODDI

apps.name: Generate images of T1
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a T1-weighted image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of T2
apps.summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a T2-weighted image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate images of tensor
apps.summary: Generates PNGs of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of each DTI (FA, MD, AD, RD) and, when present, DKI (GA, AK, MK, RK) map with FSL slicer, for quick QA of a tensor fit.

apps.name: Generate images of tissue type masks
apps.summary: Generates PNGs of gray matter, white matter, CSF and GM/WM interface masks from an MRtrix3 five-tissue-type image, optionally outlined on a T1, for QA of tissue segmentation.

apps.name: Generate images of tract endpoints on cortical surface
apps.summary: Projects tract endpoint density ROIs onto the FreeSurfer white surface and renders JPEG images of each on the cortical surface with PySurfer, for visual quality control.

apps.name: Generate Parcellation (Volume) from ROIs
apps.summary: Combines a directory of binary NIfTI ROIs into a single volumetric parcellation (one label per ROI) with key.txt and label.json, using AFNI 3dTcat and 3dTstat.

apps.name: Generate Polar Angle Parcellations from pRF - Diffusion Space
apps.summary: Generates a volumetric parcellation in DWI space by binning a pRF polar angle surface map into user-defined ranges and projecting the bins into the cortical ribbon, using FreeSurfer, Connectome Workbench and FSL.

apps.name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Analysis in Freesurfer Space (Benson pRF)
apps.summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter analysis in FreeSurfer (T1) space: V1 from a pRF visual-area segmentation, left and right LGN from FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei, the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.

apps.name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Benson pRF)
apps.summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking in DWI space: V1 and other visual areas from a pRF/Benson visual-area segmentation, left and right LGN from FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei, the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.

apps.name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Glasser Parcellation)
apps.summary: Generates ROIs for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking in DWI space from a subject-space Glasser (HCP-MMP) parcellation, FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei (LGN), the optic chiasm and FreeSurfer exclusion ROIs, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.

apps.name: Generate ROIs for Visual White Matter Tracking in dMRI Space (Glasser Parcellation) Binned by prf Eccentricity Estimates - Deprecated Surface
apps.summary: This app will generate ROIs that can be used for visual white matter tracking, including optic radiation tracking.

apps.name: Generate ROIs from an atlas
apps.summary: Extracts single or merged ROIs as NIfTI files from a volumetric parcellation by label index, with optional smoothing/inflation, using wma_tools.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in Anatomical Space
apps.summary: Generates ROIs in anatomical (T1) space from FreeSurfer labels (cortical parcellation, aseg, thalamic, hippocampal and amygdala nuclei), an optional volume parcellation and pRF visual areas, with optional merging and white matter inflation, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in DMRI Space
apps.summary: This app will generate ROIs from a parcellation, subcortical structures found in the Freesurfer aseg, cortical structures found in the Freesurfer parcellations, and population receptive field visual area segmentations. The ROIs will be resliced into diffusion space in of this, merging ROIs is allowed.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in DMRI Space (dtiinit)
apps.summary: This app will generate ROIs from a parcellation, subcortical structures found in the Freesurfer aseg, cortical structures found in the Freesurfer parcellations, and population receptive field visual area segmentations. The ROIs will be resliced into diffusion space in of this, merging ROIs is allowed.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in DMRI Space with FA Skeleton mask
apps.summary: Generates ROIs in DWI space from FreeSurfer labels, an optional volume parcellation and pRF visual areas, inflating them toward white matter with AFNI 3dROIMaker guided by a FA skeleton mask.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in DMRI Space with WM Skeleton mask
apps.summary: Generates ROIs in DWI space from FreeSurfer labels, an optional volume parcellation and pRF visual areas, inflating them toward white matter with AFNI 3dROIMaker guided by a white matter skeleton mask.

apps.name: Generate ROIs in FMRI Space
apps.summary: Generates ROIs in fMRI space from FreeSurfer labels (cortical parcellation, aseg, thalamic, hippocampal and amygdala nuclei), an optional volume parcellation and pRF visual areas, with optional merging and white matter inflation, using AFNI 3dROIMaker.

apps.name: Generate surface visualizations of ROIs for WMC Datatype Viewer
apps.summary: Utility that converts each ROI volume into a VTK surface mesh and adds it to a white matter classification so the ROIs display in the brainlife WMC viewer.

apps.name: Generate synthetic MP-RAGE T1 image from clinical FLAIR data
apps.summary: Synthesises a 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image from a clinical FLAIR image with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthSR (mri_synthsr).

apps.name: Generate synthetic MP-RAGE T1 image from T1w and T2w data using SynthSR Hyperfine
apps.summary: Synthesises a 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image from paired low-field (Hyperfine) T1w and T2w scans with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthSR Hyperfine.

apps.name: Generate synthetic MP-RAGE T1 image from T1w data
apps.summary: Synthesises a 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image from a T1-weighted image with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthSR (mri_synthsr).

apps.name: Generate synthetic MP-RAGE T1 image from T2w data
apps.summary: Synthesises a 1 mm isotropic MP-RAGE-like T1-weighted image from a T2-weighted image with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthSR (mri_synthsr).

apps.name: Generate tract endpoint maps
apps.summary: This app will generate endpoint maps for all tracts in an input classification structure.  User can specify what sort of decay/smoothing algorithm can be used (or none) and whether the output is to be normalized (e.g. max density voxel in tract endpoint mask = 1).

apps.name: Generate tract endpoint maps
apps.summary: Generates streamline endpoint density maps for every tract in a white matter classification (wmc), with exact, box or Gaussian smoothing of endpoints, masked to FreeSurfer grey matter.

apps.name: Generate tract figures (wma_pyTools)
apps.summary: Generates figures for each tract of a white matter classification with wma_pyTools: streamline anatomy plots, density GIFs, multi-tile density plots and endpoint fingerprint plots.

apps.name: Generate Visual Regions of Interest Binned by Eccentricity Estimates (Benson Atlas) - Diffusion Space
apps.summary: Generates eccentricity-binned visual-area ROIs from a pRF (Benson atlas) eccentricity map, plus LGN, optic chiasm and exclusion ROIs, in DWI space for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking, using FreeSurfer, Connectome Workbench and AFNI.

apps.name: Generate Visual Regions of Interest Binned by Eccentricity Estimates (Benson Atlas) - fMRI Space
apps.summary: Generates eccentricity-binned visual-area ROIs from a pRF (Benson atlas) eccentricity map, plus LGN, optic chiasm and exclusion ROIs, in fMRI space for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking, using FreeSurfer, Connectome Workbench and AFNI.

apps.name: Generate Visual Regions of Interest Binned by Eccentricity Estimates (Benson Atlas) - Freesurfer Space
apps.summary: Generates eccentricity-binned visual-area ROIs from a pRF (Benson atlas) eccentricity map, plus LGN, optic chiasm and exclusion ROIs, in FreeSurfer (T1) space for visual white matter and optic radiation tracking, using FreeSurfer, Connectome Workbench and AFNI.

apps.name: GLMdenoise
apps.summary: Denoises task fMRI runs with the GLMdenoise toolbox (compiled MATLAB), deriving PCA noise regressors across runs from BIDS events.tsv designs, and outputs denoised BOLD runs.

apps.name: Gyral Bias Analysis
apps.summary: Computes parcel-wise gyral bias metrics by combining FreeSurfer cortical curvature with tractography streamline counts and densities, optionally restricted to visual areas and polar-angle meridians.

apps.name: HCP Pipeline (FreeSurfer)
apps.summary: BIDS app for HCP FreeSurfer for BrainLife.

apps.name: HCP Pipeline (PostFreeSurfer)
apps.summary: BIDS app for HCP post-FreeSurfer for BrainLife.

apps.name: HCP Pipeline (PreFreeSurfer)
apps.summary: BIDS app for HCP pre-FreeSurfer for BrainLife. Performs ACPC alignment, FNIRT-based brain extraction, and bias field correction. (Please see https://github.com/Washington-University/HCPpipelines/wiki/v3.4.0-Release-Notes,-Installation,-and-Usage#structural-preprocessing for more information on HCP structural pipelines.)

apps.name: HCP Pipelines - Structural preprocessing
apps.summary: Runs the HCP Pipelines 4.1.3 structural preprocessing (PreFreeSurfer, FreeSurfer, PostFreeSurfer) on T1- and T2-weighted images with the HCP BIDS-App.

apps.name: HD-BET
apps.summary: Extracts the brain from a T1-weighted image with the HD-BET neural network, outputting the skull-stripped T1w and a binary brain mask.

apps.name: HOI_toolbox
apps.summary: Computes higher-order interaction measures (O-information or dynamic O-information) over n-plets of time series with bootstrap significance, and outputs the top redundant and synergistic combinations.

apps.name: Hybrid QSM-weighted T1 Generator
apps.summary: Generates a hybrid contrast image (HC = w1 x T1w + w2 x QSM) from a T1-weighted image and a QSM map with nibabel, improving subcortical gray matter contrast.

apps.name: hyssong-fmripreprocessing
apps.summary: Denoises an fMRIPrep-preprocessed BOLD run with AFNI and FSL: brain masking, intensity normalization, nuisance regression (24 motion, WM, CSF, global signal, high-pass) with frame censoring, and spatial smoothing.

apps.name: impact-reg
apps.summary: Registers a moving volume to a fixed volume (NIfTI or OME-Zarr, e.g. microscopy) with impact-reg-konfai using FireANTs SyN, ConvexAdam or elastix presets, on GPU or CPU, and outputs the displacement field and moved image.

apps.name: Interpolate bad channels
apps.summary: Interpolates the channels marked as bad in epoched MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python Epochs.interpolate_bads.

apps.name: Interpolate bad channels
apps.summary: Interpolates bad channels in raw MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python interpolate_bads and outputs the repaired raw .fif with a PSD plot.

apps.name: Intersect Tracts with ROI - deprecated
apps.summary: unknown

apps.name: Inverse operator
apps.summary: Builds an MNE-Python minimum-norm inverse operator from a forward solution, a noise covariance and epoched MEG data, and applies it (dSPM, SNR 3) to the averaged evoked response to output a source time course.

apps.name: Justin Reslice T1w App
apps.summary: Reslices an ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image to a new voxel size with DIPY reslice.

apps.name: Laplace Beltrami Spectrum: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
apps.summary: Computes the Laplace-Beltrami spectrum (eigenvalues and eigenvectors) of each VTK surface mesh in a 3D surfaces dataset with compiled MATLAB code.

apps.name: Laplace Beltrami Spectrum: Eigenvalues Only
apps.summary: Computes the Laplace-Beltrami spectrum (eigenvalues) of each VTK surface mesh in a 3D surfaces dataset with compiled MATLAB code and writes them to spectrum.json.

apps.name: LiFE (dwi)
apps.summary: Evaluates a tractogram with LiFE (Linear Fascicle Evaluation), predicting a preprocessed DWI from the streamlines of a .tck file, and outputs fascicle weights and model error.

apps.name: LiFE with dtiInit
apps.summary: Evaluates a tractogram with LiFE (Linear Fascicle Evaluation), predicting the diffusion signal from the streamlines of a .tck file and dtiInit-aligned DWI, and outputs fascicle weights and model error.

apps.name: Linearly align DWI to another DWI with FSL Flirt
apps.summary: Linearly aligns one DWI to another by registering their mean b0 images with FSL flirt and applying the transform to the moving DWI and its gradients with MRtrix3.

apps.name: Little Test
apps.summary: Test App from a brain imaging course that resamples an ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image to a requested voxel resolution with DIPY reslice.

apps.name: LST-AI
apps.summary: Segments multiple sclerosis white matter lesions from T1-weighted and FLAIR images with LST-AI and outputs lesion masks.

apps.name: Make BEM model
apps.summary: Builds a BEM conductor model for MEG/EEG forward modelling from a FreeSurfer subject with MNE-Python, running the watershed algorithm if BEM surfaces are missing, with QC figures and a report.

apps.name: Make Forward Solution
apps.summary: Computes an MEG/EEG forward solution (lead field) with MNE-Python make_forward_solution from the subject's source space, coregistration transform and BEM, or from the fsaverage template when none are given.

apps.name: Make Inverse Operator
apps.summary: Computes an MNE minimum-norm inverse operator for MEG/EEG source reconstruction from a forward solution, a noise covariance and sensor info from epochs, using MNE-Python.

apps.name: Make watershed BEM
apps.summary: Computes watershed BEM surfaces (inner skull, outer skull, scalp) from a FreeSurfer reconstruction with MNE-Python make_watershed_bem, for MEG/EEG forward modelling.

apps.name: Make white matter mask in dwi space from Freesurfer
apps.summary: Creates a white matter mask in DWI space from a FreeSurfer aparc+aseg segmentation with FreeSurfer mri_label2vol and mri_binarize, e.g. for tractography seeding.

apps.name: Make white matter mask in dwi space from Freesurfer (dtiinit)
apps.summary: Creates a white matter mask in DWI space from a FreeSurfer aparc+aseg segmentation, using the aligned DWI of a dtiInit output as reference, with FreeSurfer mri_label2vol and mri_binarize.

apps.name: Map  ROIs to cortical surface
apps.summary: Maps volumetric ROIs such as tract endpoints onto FreeSurfer-derived cortical surfaces in native and MNI space with FreeSurfer mri_vol2surf and Connectome Workbench, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Map Retinotopic Connections
apps.summary: Extracts the streamlines connecting two visual areas (optionally restricted to eccentricity, polar-angle and hemisphere bins) from a template tractogram using retinotopic maps and MRtrix3 tckedit, and warps the tract into subject space with ANTs.

apps.name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses
apps.summary: Maps volumetric tract endpoint ROIs onto FreeSurfer-derived cortical surfaces in native and MNI space with FreeSurfer mri_vol2surf and Connectome Workbench, with optional volume and surface smoothing, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses - fsaverage
apps.summary: Maps template-space (warped) tract endpoint ROIs onto an fsaverage cortical surface with FreeSurfer mri_vol2surf and Connectome Workbench, with optional volume and surface smoothing, as a cortexmap.

apps.name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses - fsaverage (No smoothing)
apps.summary: This app will map volumated measure files (i.e. tensor, NODDI) to the cortical surface following Fukutomi et al (2018; 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2018.02.017) using Connectome Workbench.

apps.name: Map tract endpoint ROIs to cortical surface for quantitative analyses - No smoothing available
apps.summary: This app will map volumated measure files (i.e. tensor, NODDI) to the cortical surface following Fukutomi et al (2018; 10.1016/j.neuroimage.2018.02.017) using Connectome Workbench.

apps.name: Mark bad data
apps.summary: Marks bad channels and bad time segments in raw MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python, from a channel list, a BIDS channels.tsv and annotation lines, and outputs the updated raw .fif with a PSD plot.

apps.name: Mark bad data
apps.summary: Marks bad channels and annotates bad time segments by hand in MNE-Python epoched MEG/EEG data, saving the updated epochs.

apps.name: MatLab App Example
apps.summary: Template MATLAB brainlife.io App that resamples a T1-weighted NIfTI image to a new voxel resolution; an example for App developers, not an analysis tool.

apps.name: Matlab docker test
apps.summary: Test App that runs a Brainstorm MATLAB pipeline (import, resample, PSD, notch and band-pass filtering) on an MEG FIF file and exports an HTML report.

apps.name: maxwell-v2
apps.summary: Applies Maxwell filtering (SSS, or tSSS when a buffer duration is set) to Elekta/MEGIN MEG raw data with MNE-Python, with optional automatic noisy/flat channel detection, and outputs the filtered raw FIF.

apps.name: Mean amplitude of PSD data
apps.summary: Computes the mean power spectral density amplitude of each channel within a chosen frequency band and outputs a TSV of per-channel values and a histogram.

apps.name: Merge multiple ROIs together using AFNI
apps.summary: Merges selected ROIs from an rois dataset into new combined ROIs with AFNI 3dcalc, for left and right hemisphere lists and a chosen output name.

apps.name: Merge tractmasks into individual mask
apps.summary: Utility that concatenates the individual tract masks of a tractmasks dataset into one 4D mask image with FSL fslmerge, keeping the label file.

apps.name: Merge Tractography (tcks) together with MRTrix3
apps.summary: Merges multiple tractograms into one .tck file with MRtrix3 tckedit.

apps.name: Merge Tractography (tcks) together with MRTrix3 (Two Tcks)
apps.summary: Merges two tractograms into one .tck file with MRtrix3 tckedit.

apps.name: merge2TCKs
apps.summary: Merges two MRtrix .tck tractograms into one .tck tractogram with a compiled MATLAB script.

apps.name: mergeDWI
apps.summary: Concatenates two or more DWI series (with bvals/bvecs) into a single DWI with MRtrix3 3.0_RC3 mrcat.

apps.name: mergeROI
apps.summary: Merges two named ROIs, or all ROIs, of an ROI collection into a single binary ROI with a compiled MATLAB (vistasoft) script.

apps.name: mergeTCK
apps.summary: Merges several MRtrix .tck tractograms into a single .tck tractogram with a compiled MATLAB script.

apps.name: midway align and average T1w
apps.summary: Aligns two T1-weighted images of the same subject into a midway space with FSL flirt and averages them into a single higher-SNR T1w image.

apps.name: MNE - Autoreject
apps.summary: Estimates MEG/EEG epoch rejection thresholds with autoreject and optionally repairs bad channels in epochs with autoreject or RANSAC (MNE-Python).

apps.name: MNE-BIDS-Pipeline [2]: MEEG Sensor analysis
apps.summary: Runs the sensor-level analysis steps of MNE-BIDS-Pipeline (condition contrasts, decoding, time-frequency) on MEG/EEG BIDS derivatives from the MNE-BIDS-Pipeline preprocessing App, and outputs derivatives and HTML reports.

apps.name: MNE-BIDS-Pipeline [3]: MEEG Source analysis
apps.summary: Runs the source-level steps of MNE-BIDS-Pipeline on sensor-level M/EEG BIDS derivatives: head model (FreeSurfer recon-all or the fsaverage template), BEM, source space, forward and inverse solutions (dSPM, MNE, sLORETA or eLORETA) and HTML reports.

apps.name: Morph  to average brain
apps.summary: Morphs MEG/EEG source estimates from an individual brain to the FreeSurfer fsaverage brain with MNE-Python compute_source_morph, and outputs the morphed STC, a plot and a report.

apps.name: Mouse Segmentation Pipeline
apps.summary: Skull-strips a mouse brain MRI by atlas registration and segments it into ROIs with the JHU Mori mouse atlas, using FSL, AFNI, ANTs and NiftyReg in one container.

apps.name: MRI Registration QC (FA maps)
apps.summary: Checks the quality of a diffusion registration by comparing fractional anisotropy maps from a fixed and a registered moving tensor dataset with similarity metrics (NMI, NCC, MSE, SSIM) and QC figures.

apps.name: MRI Registration QC (T1w)
apps.summary: Checks the quality of a T1-weighted image registration by computing similarity metrics (NMI, NCC, MSE, SSIM) between a fixed and a registered moving image and producing checkerboard, edge-overlay and difference QC figures.

apps.name: MRI Registration QC: Pairwise Group Comparison  (FA maps)
apps.summary: Compares every pair of FA maps from several tensor datasets with registration similarity metrics (NMI, NCC, MSE, SSIM, Dice, Jaccard) and produces per-pair QC figures and group-level metric matrices.

apps.name: MRIQC
apps.summary: Runs MRIQC pipeline (http://mriqc.readthedocs.io/en/stable/reports/smri.html) from Poldrack Lab on selected T1 anatomy.

apps.name: Mrtrix2 CSD
apps.summary: Fits constrained spherical deconvolution with MRtrix 0.2 at every even lmax up to a maximum and outputs the fibre orientation distributions and response function.

apps.name: Mrtrix2 CSD (dtiinit)
apps.summary: Fits constrained spherical deconvolution with MRtrix 0.2 at every even lmax up to a maximum and outputs the fibre orientation distributions and response function.

apps.name: MRtrix2 Tracking (dwi)
apps.summary: Tracks whole-brain streamlines from single-shell DWI with MRtrix 0.2.12 using DT_STREAM, SD_STREAM and SD_PROB, outputting three .tck tractograms and a reconstruction.

apps.name: MRtrix2 Tracking with dtiInit
apps.summary: Tracks whole-brain streamlines from a dtiInit output with MRtrix 0.2.12 using DT_STREAM, SD_STREAM and SD_PROB, outputting three .tck tractograms and a reconstruction.

apps.name: mrtrix3 - WMC Anatomically Constrained Tractography (ACT)
apps.summary: Generates a whole-brain tractogram with MRtrix3 anatomically constrained probabilistic (iFOD2) tractography from preprocessed DWI and a T1w image, with settings preset for white matter tract segmentation.

apps.name: Mrtrix3 iFOD2 ROI Tracking (dtiinit)
apps.summary: This app will generate multiple ROI to ROI tractograms using mrtrix3's probabilistic iFOD2 algorithm and anatomically constrained tractography framework (ACT).

apps.name: Mrtrix3 iFOD2 ROI Tracking (dwi)
apps.summary: Tracks streamlines between pairs of ROIs from DWI and CSD fiber orientation distributions with MRtrix3 iFOD2 probabilistic tractography (optionally anatomically constrained) and outputs a tractogram and tract classification.

apps.name: mrtrix3 preprocess
apps.summary: Preprocesses raw DWI with MRtrix3 3.0.2 following the DESIGNER-style order (PCA denoising, Gibbs ringing removal, FSL topup/eddy, bias correction, Rician noise removal, optional normalisation) and aligns it to a T1w image with epi_reg.

apps.name: Multi-Atlas Transfer Tool
apps.summary: Maps a chosen cortical atlas (Schaefer, Gordon, Yeo, HCP-MMP, AAL and others) onto a subject's FreeSurfer surfaces with maTT2 GCS classifiers and outputs volumetric and surface parcellations.

apps.name: Multi-Atlas Transfer Tool - old (w/surface output)
apps.summary: brainlife.io version of multi atlas transfer tools (maTT).

apps.name: multi-LAP
apps.summary: Segments white matter bundles in a target tractogram by solving multiple Linear Assignment Problems (multi-LAP) against example bundles from other subjects, with optional SLR registration, and outputs a WMC classification.

apps.name: multi-LAP and multi-NN (deprecated)
apps.summary: White matter bundle segmentation as multiple Linear Assignment Problems (multi-LAP). It also performs Nearest Neighbor (NN, or multi-NN) segmentation for comparison. WARNING: This App was used specifically for a Replicability Study and has been deprecated.

apps.name: my new app
apps.summary: A web service for semi-automated conversion of raw imaging data to BIDS

apps.name: N4 Bias Field Correction (T2w)
apps.summary: Corrects intensity inhomogeneity (bias field) in a T2-weighted image with ANTs N4BiasFieldCorrection, optionally restricted to a brain mask.

apps.name: Network Communities
apps.summary: Detects the community structure of networks with Louvain (several quality functions, negative weights supported), Infomap or stochastic block models, using igraph, louvain and graph-tool.

apps.name: Network Matrices
apps.summary: Builds structural network adjacency matrices (streamline count, density, length and optional tensor-based edge weights and tract profiles) from a tractogram and a volumetric parcellation with the FiNE MATLAB tool.

apps.name: Network Measurements
apps.summary: App to calculate several basic statistics for networks and their respective null model distributions.

apps.name: Network Neuro
apps.summary: Builds structural connectivity matrices from a LiFE-evaluated tractogram and the FreeSurfer aparc+aseg parcellation with the FiNE toolbox, weighted by streamline density and virtual lesion strength.

apps.name: Network Neuro Aggregator
apps.summary: Aggregates density and count connectivity matrices from several networkneuro outputs into mean and standard-deviation matrices, shown as heatmaps.

apps.name: Network Null Model
apps.summary: Generates an ensemble of null-model networks (Erdos-Renyi, Barabasi-Albert or configuration model) matching an input network, using igraph.

apps.name: Network Preprocess
apps.summary: Filters a connectivity network by weight sign, threshold and top-percentile edges and outputs the preprocessed network, weighted or binarised.

apps.name: Network Report
apps.summary: Generates an HTML report for a network (JGF), with a table of network properties and histograms of network and node attributes, optionally compared with null-model distributions, using igraph.

apps.name: Network Visualization
apps.summary: Draws a static 2D visualisation of a network with the Large Graph Layout (LGL) force-directed algorithm in igraph, colouring and sizing nodes by a chosen property, and saves it as a PDF.

apps.name: Nobrainer - BrainParcellation
apps.summary: Segments a T1-weighted image into a FreeSurfer-style whole-brain parcellation with the kwyk Bayesian neural network (nobrainer), with entropy and variance maps of prediction uncertainty.

apps.name: Noddi Amico
apps.summary: Fits the NODDI model to multi-shell DWI with the AMICO toolbox to produce neurite density (NDI), orientation dispersion (ODI), isotropic volume fraction (ISOVF) and direction maps.

apps.name: NODDI Amico (single shell)
apps.summary: Fits the NODDI model to single-shell DWI with the AMICO toolbox; only the orientation dispersion index (ODI) is reliable from single-shell data.

apps.name: NODDI Amico (single shell) - Deprecated
